questions.question: In which film does Arnold Schwarzenegger say, “Hasta la vista, baby”?
questions.note: 1991 — he says it to the T-1000, not in the 1984 original.

questions.question: Which film includes the courtroom outburst “You can’t handle the truth!”?
questions.note: 1992 — Jack Nicholson’s Colonel Jessup, opposite Tom Cruise.

questions.question: Which film popularized the line “Houston, we have a problem”?
questions.note: 1995. The real radio call was slightly different; the movie made this wording famous.

questions.question: In which film does Cuba Gooding Jr. yell, “Show me the money!”?
questions.note: 1996 — Tom Cruise’s sports agent; “You had me at hello” is the other famous line.

questions.question: Which 1995 epic includes the line “They may take our lives, but they’ll never take our freedom!”?
questions.note: Mel Gibson as William Wallace, face painted blue.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “That’ll do, pig”?
questions.note: 1995 — Farmer Hoggett to the sheep-pig, after the herding trial.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “I see dead people”?
questions.note: 1999 — Haley Joel Osment, whispering to Bruce Willis.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “One does not simply walk into Mordor”?
questions.note: Boromir (Sean Bean) at the Council of Elrond.

questions.question: In which film does the Joker ask, “Why so serious?”?
questions.note: Heath Ledger, in Christopher Nolan’s 2008 Batman film.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “I volunteer as tribute!”?
questions.note: 2012 — Jennifer Lawrence’s Katniss, stepping in for her sister Prim.
